title: Data Migration
subtitle: Comprehensive, Structured Data Conversion Services
descHeading: Fully searchable, cleansed, condensed, and standardized legacy data
descContent: CSI uses an iterative development method to ensure that legacy data appears as if it was entered originally in the new system. There’s no need to access a separate database or system to find the legacy data. Everything is unified under one database and platform. Over the years, we have used our systematic method to successfully convert legacy data for more than thirty different systems.

diagram.desc: CSI offers the most structured and comprehensive data migration services on the market. We use a tried-and-tested proprietary process to analyze and transfer legacy data to the new system. The original data is not simply copied but also cleansed, condensed, and standardized. In InfoShare™, a unique person exists a single consolidated record. Users never have to re-enter old data or remove duplicate entries. Some vendors create independent functions to access the legacy data, whereas others handle the data migration process with much less effort, resulting in inconsistent and messy data. By contrast, CSI develops tools and strategies to offer high quality data migration with data integrity assurance.

title: Low Code Development
subtitle: Proprietary low-code technology to facilitate application development
descHeading: Rapid application development with high customization and quick deployment
descContent: U.S. Patent 10,649,743 B2 entitled "Application Developing Method and System" was designed to facilitate and streamline application development for government agencies and beyond. With a low-code development solution, users don't need any expertise in programming or software architecture. The patent removes complexity from building modern applications that can be easily and quickly adapted to fulfill each agency’s missions and requirements.

diagram.desc: A low-code development platform enables developers—and anyone with simple database knowledge—to create applications with minimal coding, exponentially accelerating the development lifecycle. This frees up significant time to focus on responsibilities that really matter. Traditional coding is complex, time-consuming, and not to mention, expensive. In the long run, CSI's low-code proprietary technology significantly lowers training, deployment, modification, and maintenance costs.

steps.desc: Simple application development keeps admin teams small, agile, and focused on higher-level, value-adding activities.

items.title: Define Requirement
items.body: The development lifecycle starts with defining the requirements for the application. Even if the requirements change, a low code development platform allows users to quickly and easily update the system.

items.title: Copy Application
items.body: Find an optimal application template from the database and copy it as the base application. Each base application is an actual working application with various functions and pages.

items.title: Modify Application
items.body: Configure the application by simply changing database table fields. The application further supports automated unit testing and a debugging mode that guides users through application logic errors. Quickly develop a working prototype that can be improved with each iteration.

title: InfoShare Engine®
subtitle: Low Code Development Platform for Government ERP Application
descHeading: Patented total solution software architecture for maximum integration
descContent: A single development platform powering multiple government applications including Police, Fire, and EMS dispatch; case, records, and data management; mobile operations; field and office reporting; evidence tracking; mapping; analytics; investigations; intelligence; and related components. All applications, modules, and submodules running on the InfoShare™ Engine benefit from seamless integration, scalability, and adaptability.

diagram.desc: InfoShare Engine® is a low code development platform that empowers government application development across multiple categories. Other vendors design and code disparate applications that lack true integration, leading to large overhead expenses, inefficiencies, and additional training down the road. Other complications include high customization costs, limited scalability, and frequent delays. In contrast, CSI’s Engine® can be summarized as high speed, low cost.

title: Security
subtitle: Robust data encryption, permission, and protection
descHeading: Integrated security methodology compliant with industry security standards
descContent: CSI’s security policy ensures continuity of criminal justice information protection, from creation through dissemination, at rest or in transit and passes the stringent third-party penetration test. Integrated GovCloud security features are fully compliant with CJIS (Criminal Justice Information Services), FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards), IRS Safeguards Audit, and other government security standards.

diagram.desc: Effective security methodology eliminates security risks and vulnerabilities defined in Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 to ensure that sensitive criminal justice information is fully protected. Traditional applications lack robust security controls and are vulnerable to SQL injection, XSS, and other attacks. With integrated government cloud security features and strict authority control, CSI’s security mechanism is fully compliant with CJIS rules, FIPS, IRS Safeguards Audit Requirements, and other national security requirements.
